faq1Q: How quickly will I get a response?
faq1A: Our team typically replies within 24 hours, often much sooner during business hours.
faq2Q: Can I customize any tour package?
faq2A: Absolutely - every package can be tailored, or we can design a fully custom itinerary from scratch via "Plan My Tour".
faq3Q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq3A: Online bank transfer (with an uploaded receipt for our team to verify), or WhatsApp-coordinated payment.
faq4A: Yes, airport transfers can be included in any custom itinerary or package booking.
faq5A: Travel insurance is not included by default - see our Terms & Conditions for details and recommendations.
